facets.source_text: 1-stack-only-on-dependency: A PR stacks only when it depends on another PR, and stacks stay shallow. This is the one exception to autopilot-full step 5. Each child's owner builds on its parent's branch, not on trunk, and rebases onto that branch in autopilot-full step 3. Subagents commit in their own worktrees and never push or open PRs. When every owner reports its code-ready commit, the coordinator rebases the unpushed branches into one line (root onto trunk, each child onto its parent branch), verifies the top branch, and runs one `gh stack link` (then updates and checks each PR body with `gh pr edit <n> --body-file <rendered>` and `pr_body.py check -`). Fall back to plain `gh pr create --draft --base <parent-branch>` only when `gh stack` is unavailable. (ship-pr, ship-stack)

facets.source_text: 2-stop-at-verified: In place of autopilot-full step 8, run autopilot-full step 6 on each PR at its head in the linked stack, so a child's checks include its parent's code. An owner commits each fix in its worktree on the lowest branch that owns the code, and the coordinator replays the branches above it and pushes the line. A new head on a lower PR restacks the PRs above it, and a PR whose `git patch-id` the restack leaves unchanged keeps its verdict. Stop when each PR is verified and green at its current head, then hand the PRs to the operator. After the handoff, nobody pushes without the operator's go. A merge request in the user's task is that go. (autopilot-full)
